sections.title: 1. About these terms
paragraphs: SOVRAN LTD is registered in England and Wales, company number 15895560. Our registered office and contact details are shown above.

These terms cover the Sovran app and sovran.money website provided by the operator identified above (Sovran, we, us). The app combines a Cashu ecash wallet with Nostr profiles, encrypted messaging, nearby payments, and optional services. Features vary by platform and version. Separate service terms and third-party terms may apply to particular services; these terms do not replace them.

In the app, you agree by selecting the terms checkbox and confirming. Reading our website or Privacy Policy does not by itself constitute consent to optional data processing. You must be at least 18, have the legal capacity to agree, and use the services only where your activities are lawful.

sections.title: 2. Understand the risks before adding money
paragraphs: Cashu ecash is experimental. Bugs, compromised devices, lost keys, double spending, dishonest counterparties, service failures, and unavailable or insolvent mints can cause permanent loss. Use only small amounts you can afford to lose. The app does not guarantee profit, stable value, deposit insurance, or uninterrupted access. A mint’s redemption obligations are governed by its own terms and applicable law; these terms do not cancel those obligations.

The wallet lets you control local keys and ecash proofs. You rely on the issuing mint to maintain any promised backing and redeem its ecash. The app does not verify its reserves. Holding ecash is not the same as holding bitcoin directly on-chain. A listed or recommended mint, rating, balance, or successful test is not proof of reserves or a guarantee. Check the issuer and its terms, including for any Sovran-branded mint; these app terms do not promise that every mint is independent of Sovran.
An issuer may impose redemption deadlines or require ecash issued under retired keys to be refreshed. Check its terms and notices; recovery may depend on redeeming or refreshing before a deadline.

The app sends requests to mints and payment services to carry out actions you authorize. Some enabled features automate steps, including receiving ecash and routing swaps through intermediary mints. Review destinations, units, amounts, permissions, fees, and trust settings. A timeout does not necessarily mean a payment failed: check its status before retrying. Offline receipt is not final validation that ecash is spendable.

sections.title: 3. Protect your wallet and identity
paragraphs: Protect your device, recovery phrases, private keys, ecash tokens, and backups. Anyone obtaining bearer ecash or a private key may spend funds or act as you. Do not send these secrets to support or post them publicly. A public Nostr key is an identifier, not a password.

Keep suitable backups before deleting data, uninstalling, importing accounts, or changing devices. A Nostr key alone does not restore your Cashu wallet. Imported identities may require their own key backups. Seed recovery depends on the relevant mint, protocol support, and transaction history; it is not a guarantee of recovering every token, message, or balance. Sovran does not offer a master password reset or a guaranteed reversal or recovery service.

You are responsible for the transactions and third-party connections you authorize and for applicable taxes and lawful use. This responsibility does not remove our own legal obligations or your rights where we are at fault.

sections.title: 4. Other services and paid features
paragraphs: Mints, relays, caches, search services, media hosts, merchant directories, on-chain services, and payment providers have their own availability, charges, privacy practices, and terms. The app may use default services before you customize them. The Privacy Policy explains the resulting data flows.

Where an older install still holds an unused Routstr credit balance, Settings may offer a legacy recovery tool to reclaim remaining credits from the configured Routstr node back into your wallet. Active AI chat, remote-signer connections, and eSIM services are not provided in this app. Neither app content nor third-party service data is personalized financial, legal, tax, or medical advice.

Payment fees, mint fees, and optional paid third-party services such as on-chain transaction acceleration can create obligations separate from using the free app. Review the amount, supplier, delivery, validity, compatibility, cancellation, and refund terms shown before paying. A network payment may be irreversible even where you retain a legal claim for a refund. These terms do not waive statutory cancellation or refund rights.

sections.title: 5. Public content and acceptable use
paragraphs: Public Nostr profiles, reports, and location-channel messages may be copied, indexed, and retained outside Sovran. Do not publish secrets, bearer tokens, or another person’s personal information without a lawful basis. You retain rights to your own content and must have the rights needed to share it. You authorize the processing and distribution necessary to carry out your requested publication; you are not transferring ownership to Sovran.

Do not use Sovran to share child sexual abuse material, sexual exploitation, non-consensual intimate imagery, pornography or sexually explicit nudity, gratuitous graphic violence, credible threats, harassment, hateful abuse, scams, malware, stolen material, or other unlawful content. Do not evade protective measures or interfere with other users or services.

Use the available report and block controls for objectionable accounts. A Nostr report is a public signed event that identifies you, the reported account, and the reason you chose; reporting a private-message sender does not include the private message text or event ID. A report is not a private complaint or a guarantee that a relay or moderator will act. You can also contact the operator above for concerns about Sovran-operated services. Blocking hides supported content in your app; it does not erase it from the network or stop someone using another identity.

For services under our control, we may restrict content or access where reasonably necessary to address unlawful activity, these rules, or security threats. We will explain the reason where appropriate and legally permitted. Contact us to challenge a restriction. We cannot remove every copy held by independent services or recipients.

sections.title: 6. Availability, changes, and stopping use
paragraphs: We maintain evolving software and cannot promise that every feature will always be available or free of defects. Keep backups and install appropriate security updates. We will give reasonable notice of significant changes or discontinuation where practicable; urgent security or legal issues may require faster action. Changes do not retrospectively remove accrued rights or change an already completed purchase.

Each app version includes copies of these terms and the Privacy Policy. When an installed update changes either document, the app asks you to review and confirm again. Website changes alone do not silently record agreement in an older app. You may read both documents in Settings or at https://sovran.money/terms and https://sovran.money/privacy.

If you do not agree to new terms, stop using the affected services. The review screen offers access to existing recovery information without recording agreement. Secure your keys and funds before deleting local data. Removing the app or a local profile does not reverse payments or erase public network records.

sections.title: 7. Responsibility and your legal rights
paragraphs: The risk notices explain the limitations of experimental software and independent networks. They do not make you waive all claims against us. We are not responsible for loss caused solely by an independent third party or by your own actions where we have not breached a duty owed to you. This does not excuse our own failure to exercise legally required care or perform obligations we have undertaken.

Nothing here excludes liability for fraud, fraudulent misrepresentation, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any liability that the law does not allow us to exclude. Mandatory consumer rights concerning digital content, services, accuracy of descriptions, reasonable care, and remedies remain available. We do not impose a blanket indemnity, mandatory paid arbitration, or a waiver of class or collective rights.

If a problem arises, contact the operator above with non-secret details. Trying to resolve it with us is optional and does not restrict your right to approach a regulator or competent court. Applicable law determines jurisdiction and your rights; these terms do not require consumers to give up mandatory protections in their country. If a provision is invalid, the remaining provisions apply where they can lawfully do so.

sections.title: 8. Software licenses
paragraphs: The source code and included third-party components remain subject to their respective open-source licenses. These terms govern the services and user conduct; they do not revoke permissions granted by those licenses. Independently operated forks and third-party deployments are not automatically operated or endorsed by Sovran.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: Explains what stays on your device, what goes to services and public networks, and how to manage or request deletion of your data.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible and what this covers
paragraphs: This policy covers the Sovran app and sovran.money website. The operator identified above is responsible for personal information it processes for its own services. Independent mints, relays, caches, search services, media hosts, map and merchant providers, on-chain services, and app stores may act as separate controllers under their own policies. Contact the operator above for privacy questions or requests.

A public key, wallet identifier, IP address, or payment record can be personal information even if it does not contain your real name. Sovran is not anonymous by default. Information leaves your device when the app communicates with services, including default services used to load content. Acknowledging this notice is not consent to every use of personal information.

sections.title: 2. Information stored on your device
paragraphs: The app stores wallet settings, local profiles, keys, ecash proofs, transaction records, local npub.cash receive sync cursors, cached Nostr profiles, mint reviews, and messages, moderation preferences, and document acceptance records. Upgraded installs from earlier versions may also retain legacy records on disk, including saved AI conversation excerpts shown in historical AI payment details and legacy remote-signer pairing records kept only for compatibility and deletion. Private key material held by the app uses operating-system secure storage; other app data uses local databases, files, or settings storage. Not all local app data is encrypted by Sovran.

Locally held recovery phrases and private keys are not intended to be uploaded as part of ordinary app operation. Copying, exporting, sharing, device backups, malware, or another person with access to your device can expose data. Do not paste secrets into public messages, support requests, or untrusted apps. We cannot promise to recover locally lost keys.

sections.title: 3. Wallet and payments
paragraphs: Mints and payment providers receive the requests needed to issue, validate, swap, redeem, or pay with ecash. Depending on the operation these include proofs being spent, blinded outputs, invoices, payment destinations, amounts, timestamps, public locking keys, and network information such as your IP address. Ecash blinding limits certain links; it does not make every payment or network request untraceable.

To receive Lightning payments to your Nostr identity, the app performs routine authenticated sync with npub.cash using NIP-98 signed WebSocket connections and periodic polling, and keeps a local sync cursor on your device. If you claim a Lightning username, the app submits your requested username to npub.cash under your active Nostr identity. Paying a Lightning address or LNURL contacts the recipient’s payment domain to resolve and request an invoice, including npub.cash when a contact has no custom Lightning address published.

Recipients receive what you send them, including payment requests, tokens, invoices, and any included message. Public zaps can associate your Nostr identity with a recipient and amount. On-chain transaction lookups and optional paid transaction acceleration use mempool.space, and blockchain transactions reveal transaction information publicly and permanently. Do not publish bearer tokens unless you intend others to redeem them.

To keep balances and status current, the app fetches Bitcoin exchange rates from Coinbase (with mempool.space as fallback) and performs direct connectivity checks against Coinbase (/v2/time), your configured Nostr relays, and your selected mint’s /v1/info endpoint. Mint discovery, monitoring, and reviews query Nostr NIP-87 relay events and public HTTP mint auditors — by default MintRadar, Cashu Auditor (api.audit.8333.space), IMF.gg, and uCash Auditor, plus optional opt-in Macadamia Auditor — and may send a local NUT-04 mint-quote probe to a mint to classify whether it is a test mint.

sections.title: 4. Nostr profiles, search, and media
paragraphs: Publishing to Nostr sends signed events to relays. Public events may contain your public key, profile name, biography, picture, website, payment address, follows, and timestamps. Other users, indexers, search services, and anyone accessing those relays may read and copy them. Public content can be associated with your activity across apps.

Loading profiles, contacts, searches, and mint reviews reads data directly from configured caches, search relays, and public Nostr relays. Defaults include Primal’s cache servers (cache1.primal.net and cache2.primal.net), public Nostr relays including relay.primal.net, and Vertex search (relay.vertexlab.io), which uses signed Nostr requests and is enabled by default. Verifying a NIP-05 identifier or resolving one during a send also queries the identifier’s domain at /.well-known/nostr.json with the requested name. Operators and queried domains can observe requested identifiers, search terms, connection times, and IP addresses. Network settings let you disable Primal hosts, toggle Vertex search, or adjust relays.

Selected uploads go to a media server, by default Primal’s Blossom server, or the configured alternative. Uploaded files may be publicly retrievable by URL and may contain identifying details or embedded metadata; do not assume these are stripped. Viewing remote images, avatars, previews, or web pages contacts their host, and opening the emoji picker may prefetch animated Google Noto Emoji assets from fonts.gstatic.com; those hosts receive the asset request and network metadata such as your IP address.

sections.title: 5. Messages, reports, and blocks
paragraphs: Supported private Nostr messages are encrypted on the device for their recipients. Relays store or forward encrypted events and may see routing information and connection metadata. Encryption does not prevent recipients from copying messages, compromised devices from exposing them, or linked and uploaded media from being fetched separately. Public chats are not private messages. Experimental messaging transports may have different metadata protections.

Reporting publishes a signed Nostr report that identifies you, the reported account, and the reason you chose; reporting a private-message sender does not include the private message text or event ID. Do not include private messages or sensitive details in public reports. Contacting the operator directly sends the information you include and your contact details to the operator and its communications provider.

Blocking takes effect locally first. The app attempts to sync your Nostr mute list; newly added private entries are encrypted for your identity, while existing public entries from other clients may remain public. Relays still see event metadata. The optional private-message word filter works locally; it does not send a dictionary or the matched plaintext to a moderation service.

sections.title: 6. Optional location, nearby communication, NFC, and device access
paragraphs: Device permissions are requested for features such as camera scanning, choosing media, location, nearby Bluetooth communication, and NFC. Device motion sensors may also be read locally on your device for wallpaper parallax effects without transmitting motion data off-device. Granting an operating-system permission does not make everything captured by the sensor public; what is transmitted depends on the feature you use. You can change permissions in device settings.

Location-based BitChat channels use a geographic cell derived from your location. Joining or posting to a cell can disclose your area to relays and participants, including precise, block-level location. Resolving place names also uses the operating system’s reverse-geocoding service, which may send coordinates to its geocoding provider. A public post with a geographic tag remains public after you leave. Nearby Bluetooth communication (used by BitChat and Nut Drop) exposes presence and relevant identifiers or messages to nearby devices and relaying peers. On Android, the nearby mesh can continue running in the background with an ongoing notification to handle nearby messages and payments. Nearby communication does not guarantee anonymity.

NFC is used as a tag reader and writer only — the app does not emulate an NFC payment card or tag. On Android, the wallet home screen can listen for nearby NFC payment tags while open so you can tap a tag to pay or receive, and you can explicitly scan or write payment tags on supported devices.

The payment-location setting is separate from public location chat. Locally stored payment location is used to show your own payment history; it is not permission to publish that history. Merchant maps fetch merchant catalog and place-detail data directly from BTC Map (api.btcmap.org) and display map tiles and markers through Apple Maps on iOS and Google Maps on Android. Disable features you do not want and review the specific disclosure before sharing location.

sections.title: 7. Legacy Routstr credit recovery
paragraphs: Active AI chat and eSIM services are not part of this app. For users upgrading from an earlier install that still holds unused Routstr credits, Settings may show a legacy recovery option. Using that recovery option contacts api.routstr.com or the previously recorded Routstr node URL with your stored recovery credentials solely to reclaim remaining credits back into your wallet. That external node receives your request and network metadata under its own privacy practices.

sections.title: 8. Website, diagnostics, and support
paragraphs: Our production hosting provider, Railway, and other website hosts receive network requests to sovran.money, including IP addresses, URLs, timestamps, and technical browser or device information. The replacement sovran.money website does not include analytics scripts or browser preference storage.

Builds that expose diagnostic tools include local logging and export; persistent developer logging is not a standard production feature. An export you choose to share can contain sensitive wallet or activity information; review it and use a private channel. App stores and operating systems may separately collect crash, installation, or diagnostic information according to their settings and policies. This policy does not promise that independent infrastructure keeps no access logs.

Support and privacy requests include the contact information and details you supply. We use those details to respond, investigate a problem, and handle the request. Never send a recovery phrase, private key, bearer token, or complete unredacted wallet database to support.

sections.title: 9. Purposes, legal bases, and recipients
paragraphs: For processing under our control, we use information to deliver the website and any Sovran-operated service, respond to support, maintain service security and reliability, address abuse, and comply with legal obligations. Where UK or EU data-protection law applies, the relevant bases are performance of a contract for requested services, legitimate interests in service reliability, security, and support where those interests do not override your rights, legal obligations where applicable, and consent where a specific optional activity requires it. A terms checkbox is not a substitute for such consent.

Information reaches the recipients described in the feature sections, infrastructure providers supporting our services, and authorities where disclosure is legally required. Public publication deliberately makes information available to others. An independent service you choose is governed by its own terms; this does not remove our obligations for processing that we control.

Public networks and independent service providers can operate in other countries with different privacy laws. You cannot limit a public Nostr event to one country. Our sovran.money website is configured in Railway’s Amsterdam region, but this does not mean all hosting-provider processing stays in the Netherlands. Railway’s published Data Processing Addendum describes processing in the United States and safeguards for applicable transfers, including standard contractual clauses and the UK Addendum. You can read those terms at https://railway.com/legal/dpa or contact us for information about safeguards for a particular service. Independent services you use have their own transfer arrangements.

sections.title: 10. Retention and deletion
paragraphs: Local records remain until removed by the app’s cache management, by you, or by deleting app data. Operating-system backups and secure storage may survive some reinstalls. Settings → Delete account attempts to remove local profiles, settings, secure keys, and wallet databases; filesystem caches, diagnostic exports, backups, or data whose cleanup failed may remain. Move funds and back up necessary keys first. It does not close every account with an external service.

Public events and third-party copies may be retained indefinitely. Nostr deletion requests cannot compel every relay, indexer, or recipient to delete a copy. Uploaded media remains on the configured Blossom media server under that server’s own retention and deletion policies; deleting local app data clears local records without erasing remote server copies. Blocking is not deletion. Blockchain records cannot be erased by Sovran.

We do not automatically export production server logs to another logging service or storage destination outside Railway. Railway currently makes seven days of log history available under our hosting plan. Its documentation says upgrading can make older logs accessible, so this window is not a guarantee that all copies are permanently erased after seven days. Other records, including support correspondence and copies held by independent services, have separate retention arrangements.

For records under our control, retention depends on the purpose: service records for the period needed to deliver and reconcile the service, support correspondence while resolving the request and related disputes, security records while investigating or preventing abuse, and records required by law for the applicable legal period. These are purpose-based retention criteria, not a single deletion deadline for all data. Contact us for the retention period applicable to your request. Independent providers set their own retention periods.

To request access or deletion of information held by Sovran, email the address above with your public identifier where relevant. Do not send secret credentials. We may request proportionate proof that you control the relevant account. We will explain if a legal obligation or another valid exception prevents deletion. You can use this contact route without reinstalling or signing into the app.

sections.title: 11. Your choices and rights
paragraphs: You can limit optional features, adjust network settings, revoke device permissions, remove local data, and stop using a service. These choices do not recall information already published or delivered. Where processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing.

Your right to object: where we rely on legitimate interests, you may object to processing based on your particular situation. We must stop unless we demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds that override your interests, rights and freedoms, or need the processing for legal claims. You can always object to processing for direct marketing. Contact the operator above to make an objection.

Depending on the law that applies, you may have rights to access, correct, erase, or receive a portable copy of your information, restrict processing, and complain to your data-protection authority. Contact the operator above to exercise rights. You do not need to waive these rights to use Sovran.
You may complain to the UK Information Commissioner’s Office (ICO) at https://ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint/ or to another competent data-protection authority. You do not have to contact us first.

Sovran is intended for adults aged 18 or over. If you believe a child has provided personal information to a Sovran-operated service, contact us. Public content, payment risks, and external services make this app unsuitable for children.

sections.title: 12. Updates to this policy
paragraphs: The date and content revision identify this policy. The app asks you to acknowledge a changed policy when you install an update containing it, separately from agreeing to the terms. A website update does not silently record acknowledgment on your device. Acknowledgment records the version and time locally; it does not authorize new optional processing. Where a change requires fresh consent or a prominent feature-specific disclosure, that must be obtained separately before the affected processing.
